title: The Security Flag in the IPv4 Header
summary: An April 1st joke RFC. It proposes a bit in the IPv4 header that senders set to 1 if the packet has malicious intent, so firewalls could tell bad packets from merely unusual ones. The humor is that attackers would never honestly set it. It is an informational April Fools memo and not a real protocol.

eli5.summary: Imagine every sneaky person had to wear a sign saying I am sneaky. That is the joke here: a flag on bad network traffic that bad guys are asked to turn on. It was published as an April Fools prank.
